operations.description: List the spaces the account can see, one page per call; the walk sends the start from _links.next and ends on a page without it
Read one space by its key
List one space's content of one type (spaceKey, type page or blogpost), one page per call; the walk sends the start from _links.next and ends on a page without it

List the content a CQL query selects, such as the pages of one space modified since a time (space = KEY and type = page and lastmodified >= "2026-09-01" order by lastmodified desc), one page per call; the walk sends the cursor from _links.next and ends on a page without it
Read one page; ask for expand body.storage to receive its body in storage format
List one page's comments (location footer for footer comments), one page per call; the walk sends the start from _links.next and ends on a page without it

Search the site with a CQL query (cql, required; such as type = page and text ~ "release notes"), one page of results per call, each with title, excerpt, url, lastModified and the matched content; the walk sends the cursor from _links.next and ends on a page without it
